correctness.rationale: For centered base B, the polar of the bipyramid translated by axial z has t∈[−1/(b+z),1/(a−z)] and horizontal sections (1+zt) B°. Fubini gives J_d(z;a,b)=[(a/(a−z))^d−(b/(b+z))^d]/(dz), with continuous value 1/a+1/b at z=0. Its derivative is [G_d(T)−G_d(R)]/(dz²), G_d(u)=u^d(d+1−du). At centroid z=(a−b)/(d+1), derivative<0 by H′(r)>0; at apex midpoint z=(a−b)/2 derivative>0 by the explicit G comparison. Strict polar-volume convexity yields unique s between them. Envelope differentiation gives monotonicity; Taylor in δ and z has coefficient (d−1)/(2(d+2)). Independently verified exact Sympy differentiation and signs for d=2,3,4,6,9 with positive rational heights and Taylor coefficient. Finite tests do not replace all-d proof. d=2 valid, sign reverses for a<b; a=b centered.
